name: The Last Talk
source:
Alexander has a monotonous and routine life, until one day a little girl with cat ears sneaks into his house and offers him to have tea with her.

[From [url=https://penper-gwittd.itch.io/the-last-talk]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
亞歷山大的生活單調而一成不變。直到某天，一個長著貓耳的小女孩悄悄溜進他家，邀請他一起喝茶。

[摘自[url=https://penper-gwittd.itch.io/the-last-talk]itch.io[/url]]
